summary: The guarded helper corrects the full-collection spawn identity failure while preserving all 20 count-boundary cases, all 18 original assertions, all state comparisons, real multiprocessing, and original numerical/deadline checks. criteria.criterion: Review exact immutable baseline-to-candidate diff and commit ancestry; allow only count-boundary tests/helpers and evidence within this correction.
Preserve all 20 original parameterized count-boundary cases and every numerical/state assertion.
Use guarded standalone-process isolation for collection-sensitive spawn; execute the helper through its actual module entrypoint.
Preserve real multiprocessing spawn, normal production training, and worker acceptance; no mocks, guard changes, skip/exclusion changes, numeric tolerance relaxation, or timeout weakening.
Parent sampler.get is called exactly once and retains the realized [7, 13] partition over a 100-item backing TensorDataset.
Report, returned payload, and accepted worker-state count all equal 2; endpoint remains 1.622 with abs=1e-12.
Corrupted spawned count remains rejected in uniform and sample modes; preserve all model/parameter/gradient/dispatch/server/checkpoint rollback assertions and all three rational retries.
Preserve missing-history-count resume rollback of committed state, authority, pending RNG, snapshots, live RNG, checkpoint bytes, then corrected-count retry and committed round 3.
Preserve both callback events and four malformed count/key types, rollback and no pending state, unchanged checkpoint bytes, successful retry/counts and saved round 2.
Independent green runs must collect tests in full and select all 20 count-boundary tests under both Python 3.13 and Python 3.14; record zero skips, exit status and exact selected node identities.
Compare independent two-case full-collection red baselines to candidate behavior; retain root full-suite failure and isolation receipt references with verified log hashes.
Observe actual multiprocessing workers and helper execution, require worker completion and no surviving tracked descendants; do not rerun unrelated full suites or create mirror tests.
If DP correction is in candidate ancestry, compare its protected test and evidence blobs byte-for-byte with f342a5a6021cee938e0b880eca5919e09ace1981; do not repeat DP review.
Keep source and environments unchanged; disable bytecode and redirect all generated artifacts/caches to scratch.

isolation_review.standalone_canonical_import_pattern: __main__ imports run from tests.integration.feddyn_partition_worker, so observer class pickle resolves through a canonical module; worker __mp_main__ does not execute the guarded scenario.
isolation_review.failure_propagation: Imports are unconditional; worker assertions raise normally; helper exit status, observation files, numerical outputs and active-child state are asserted. There is no exception catch or fallback path in the new helper.
isolation_review.observer_effect: Only reads sampler.indices/length, trainer.trainset length and attempt count at epoch start; writes observations. It never calls sampler.get or iterates/draws the sampler, never loads batches or alters optimizer/model/config.
